questions.q: If $\vec a=2\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k, \vec b=\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+2\hat k$ and $|\vec a+\vec b|=|\vec a-\vec b|$, then $\alpha+\beta$ is equal to
questions.explanation: $|\vec a+\vec b|=|\vec a-\vec b|\Rightarrow \vec a\cdot\vec b=0\Rightarrow 2\alpha+2\beta-2=0\Rightarrow \alpha+\beta=1$.

questions.q: If $\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k, \vec b=\hat j-\hat k$ and $\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b, \vec a\cdot\vec c=3$, then $\vec c$ is
questions.explanation: Let $\vec c=(x,y,z)$. $\vec a\times\vec c=(z-y,x-z,y-x)=(0,1,-1)$ gives $z=y,\ x-z=1$. With $x+y+z=3$: $3y+1=3\Rightarrow y=\tfrac23$, so $x=\tfrac53,z=\tfrac23$, i.e. $\vec c=\tfrac53\hat i+\tfrac23\hat j+\tfrac23\hat k$.

questions.q: The value of $\lambda$ for which the vectors $\vec a=2\hat i+\lambda\hat j+\hat k$ and $\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k$ are orthogonal is
questions.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b=2+2\lambda+3=0\Rightarrow \lambda=-\dfrac52$.

questions.q: If $\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k$, $\vec b=\hat i-\hat j+4\hat k$ and $\vec c=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$ are such that $\vec a+\lambda \vec b$ is perpendicular to $\vec c$, then the value of $\lambda$ is
questions.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec c=4$, $\vec b\cdot\vec c=4$; $(\vec a+\lambda\vec b)\cdot\vec c=0\Rightarrow4+4\lambda=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-1$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a|=10, |\vec b|=2$ and $\vec a.\vec b=12$, then the value of $|\vec a\times \vec b|$ is
questions.explanation: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{12}{20}=0.6$, so $\sin\theta=0.8$; $|\vec a\times\vec b|=10\times2\times0.8=16$.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: Statement (I): If either $|\vec a|=0$ or $|\vec b|=0$, then $\vec a.\vec b=0$. Statement (II): If $\vec a\times\vec b=\vec 0$, then $\vec a$ is perpendicular to $\vec b$. Which of the following is correct?
options: Statement (I) is true but Statement (II) is false
Statement (I) is false but Statement (II) is true
Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are true
Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are false
questions.explanation: $\vec a\times \vec b=\vec0$ actually means the vectors are parallel, not perpendicular, so Statement (II) is false while Statement (I) is true.

questions.q: The vectors $\vec{AB}=3\hat i+4\hat k$ and $\vec{AC}=5\hat i-2\hat j+4\hat k$ are the sides of a $\triangle ABC$. The length of the median through A is
questions.explanation: The median from A is $\dfrac12(\vec{AB}+\vec{AC})=\dfrac12(8\hat i-2\hat j+8\hat k)=4\hat i-\hat j+4\hat k$, with length $\sqrt{16+1+16}=\sqrt{33}$.

questions.q: Let $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ be two unit vectors and $\theta$ is the angle between them. Then $\vec a+\vec b$ is a unit vector if
questions.explanation: $|\vec a+\vec b|^2=1+1+2\cos\theta=1 \Rightarrow \cos\theta=-\dfrac12 \Rightarrow \theta=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a + \vec b| = |\vec a - \vec b|$ then
questions.explanation: Squaring both sides gives $\vec a \cdot \vec b = 0$, so $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ are perpendicular.

questions.q: The component of $\hat i$ in the direction of the vector $\hat i + \hat j + 2\hat k$ is
questions.explanation: Component $= \dfrac{\hat i \cdot (\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k)}{|\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k|} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt6} = \dfrac{\sqrt6}{6}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a + 2\vec b + 3\vec c = \vec 0$ and $(\vec a \times \vec b) + (\vec b \times \vec c) + (\vec c \times \vec a) = \lambda(\vec b \times \vec c)$ then the value of $\lambda$ is equal to
questions.explanation: With $\vec a = -2\vec b-3\vec c$: $\vec a\times\vec b=3(\vec b\times\vec c)$ and $\vec c\times\vec a=2(\vec b\times\vec c)$, so the sum $=6(\vec b\times\vec c)$, giving $\lambda=6$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a \times \vec b|^2 + |\vec a \cdot \vec b|^2 = 144$ and $|\vec a| = 4$ then $|\vec b|$ is equal to
questions.explanation: Using $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2$, we get $16|\vec b|^2=144 \Rightarrow |\vec b|=3$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a| = 2$ and $|\vec b| = 3$ and the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is 120°, then the length of the vector $\left|\dfrac{1}{2}\vec a - \dfrac{1}{3}\vec b\right|^2$ is
questions.explanation: $\left|\frac12\vec a-\frac13\vec b\right|^2=\frac14|\vec a|^2+\frac19|\vec b|^2-\frac13(\vec a\cdot\vec b)=1+1-\frac13(-3)=3$. Note: the KEA key marks this question as "1234" (all four options awarded), i.e. full marks given to everyone, even though only option C (3) is mathematically correct.

questions.q: If $|\vec a \times \vec b|^2 + |\vec a \cdot \vec b|^2 = 36$ and $|\vec a| = 3$ then $|\vec b|$ is equal to
questions.explanation: Using $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2$, we get $9|\vec b|^2=36\Rightarrow|\vec b|=2$. The printed question shows $|\vec a\times\vec b|$ without a square, which makes it dimensionally inconsistent (unanswerable as literally printed) — the KEA key awarded a grace mark for this question, most likely because of this printing error. (as per KEA key)

questions.q: If $\vec\alpha = \hat i - 3\hat j$, $\vec\beta = \hat i + 2\hat j - \hat k$ then express $\vec\beta$ in the form $\vec\beta = \vec\beta_1 + \vec\beta_2$ where $\vec\beta_1$ is parallel to $\vec\alpha$ and $\vec\beta_2$ is perpendicular to $\vec\alpha$ then $\vec\beta_1$ is given by
questions.explanation: $\vec\beta_1=\frac{\vec\alpha\cdot\vec\beta}{|\vec\alpha|^2}\vec\alpha=\frac{-5}{10}(\hat i-3\hat j)=-\frac12(\hat i-3\hat j)$, which does not match any printed option exactly — this appears to be a defective question, consistent with the KEA key awarding a grace mark here. Option (A) is picked as the closest in form. (as per KEA key)

questions.q: A vector $\vec a$ makes equal acute angles on the coordinate axis. Then the projection of vector $\vec b$ = 5$\hat i$ + 7$\hat j$ $-\hat k$ on $\vec a$ is
questions.explanation: Equal acute angles give direction cosines $1/\sqrt3$ each; projection = $\vec b\cdot\hat a=(5+7-1)/\sqrt3=11/\sqrt3$.

questions.q: The diagonals of a parallelogram are the vectors 3$\hat i$ + 6$\hat j$ $-2\hat k$ and $-\hat i-2\hat j-8\hat k$ then the length of the shorter side of parallelogram is
questions.explanation: The sides are half the sum and difference of the diagonals; as printed this gives lengths $\sqrt{30}$ and $\sqrt{29}$, matching none of the options exactly (apparent sign typo in the question), so KEA awarded grace marks. Taking the likely-intended diagonal, the shorter side works out to $\sqrt{14}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ = 0 and $\vec a+\vec b$ makes an angle 60$^\circ$ with $\vec a$ then
questions.explanation: cos60$^\circ = |\vec a|/|\vec a+\vec b| = 1/2$, so $|\vec a+\vec b|=2|\vec a|$; since $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$, $|\vec a+\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2+|\vec b|^2$ gives $|\vec b|=\sqrt3|\vec a|$.

questions.q: If the area of the parallelogram with $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ as two adjacent sides is 15 sq. units then the area of the parallelogram having 3$\vec a$+2$\vec b$ and $\vec a$+3$\vec b$ as two adjacent sides in sq. units is
questions.explanation: $(3\vec a+2\vec b)\times(\vec a+3\vec b)=7(\vec a\times\vec b)$, so the new area = 7 $\times$ 15 = 105.

questions.q: The area of the quadrilateral ABCD, when A(0, 4, 1) B(2, 3, $-$1) C(4, 5, 0) and D(2, 6, 2) is equal to
questions.explanation: Area = $\frac12|\vec{AC}\times\vec{BD}| = \frac12|(6,-12,12)| = \frac12(18)=9$ sq. units.

questions.q: The two vectors $\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$ and $\hat i+3\hat j+5\hat k$ represent the two sides $\vec{AB}$ and $\vec{AC}$ respectively of a $\triangle ABC$. The length of the median through A is
questions.explanation: Median vector $=\dfrac{\vec{AB}+\vec{AC}}{2}=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k$, whose magnitude is $\sqrt{14}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ are unit vectors and $\theta$ is the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$, then $\sin\dfrac{\theta}{2}$ is
questions.explanation: $|\vec a-\vec b|^2=2-2\cos\theta=4\sin^2(\theta/2)$, so $\sin(\theta/2)=|\vec a-\vec b|/2$.

questions.q: If the vectors $2\hat i-3\hat j+4\hat k$, $2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k$ and $\lambda\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k$ are coplanar, then the value of $\lambda$ is
questions.explanation: Setting the scalar triple product to zero and expanding gives $6-\lambda=0\Rightarrow\lambda=6$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=144$ and $|\vec a|=6$, then $|\vec b|$ is equal to
questions.explanation: $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2=144$, so $36|\vec b|^2=144\Rightarrow|\vec b|=2$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a| = 16, |\vec b| = 4$ then $\sqrt{|\vec a \times \vec b|^2+|\vec a \cdot \vec b|^2} =$
questions.explanation: By the identity $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2$, the required value is $\sqrt{|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2}=|\vec a||\vec b|=16\times4=64$.

questions.q: If the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is $\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$ and the projection of $\vec a$ in the direction of $\vec b$ is $-2$, then $|\vec a| =$
questions.explanation: Projection $=|\vec a|\cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=-\dfrac{|\vec a|}{2}=-2$, so $|\vec a|=4$.

questions.q: A unit vector perpendicular to the plane containing the vectors $\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k$ and $-2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k$ is
questions.explanation: The cross product of the two vectors is $(5,-5,5)$; normalising the opposite direction gives the unit vector $\dfrac{-\hat i+\hat j-\hat k}{\sqrt3}$.

questions.q: $[\vec a+2\vec b-\vec c,\ \vec a-\vec b,\ \vec a-\vec b-\vec c] =$
questions.explanation: Expanding the scalar triple product using the coefficient matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&2&-1\\1&-1&0\\1&-1&-1\end{pmatrix}$ gives determinant 3, so the result is $3[\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]$.

questions.q: If $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=144$ and $|\vec a|=4$, then the value of $|\vec b|$ is
questions.explanation: Using $|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+|\vec a\cdot\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2$, $16|\vec b|^2=144\Rightarrow|\vec b|=3$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ are mutually perpendicular unit vectors, then $(3\vec a+2\vec b)\cdot(5\vec a-6\vec b)=$

If the vectors $a\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$, $\hat i+b\hat j+\hat k$ and $\hat i+\hat j+c\hat k$ are coplanar $(a
eq b
eq c
eq1)$, then the value of $abc-(a+b+c)=$
questions.explanation: Setting the determinant of the three vectors to zero and expanding gives $abc-(a+b+c)=-2$.

questions.q: If $\vec a=\hat i+\lambda\hat j+2\hat k$; $\vec b=\mu\hat i+\hat j-\hat k$ are orthogonal and $|\vec a|=|\vec b|$ then $(\lambda,\mu)=$
questions.explanation: Orthogonality gives $\mu+\lambda=2$; equal magnitudes give $\mu^2-\lambda^2=3$; solving yields $\lambda=1/4,\ \mu=7/4$.

questions.q: If $\vec a=2\hat i+\lambda\hat j+\hat k$ and $\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k$ are orthogonal, then value of $\lambda$ is
questions.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b=2+2\lambda+3=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-\dfrac52$.

questions.q: If $\vec a,\vec b,\vec c$ are unit vectors such that $\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec 0$, then the value of $\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a$ is equal to
questions.explanation: $|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=0=3+2(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a)$, giving the sum $=-\dfrac32$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ are unit vectors, then angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ for $\sqrt3\vec a-\vec b$ to be a unit vector is
questions.explanation: $|\sqrt3\vec a-\vec b|^2=3+1-2\sqrt3\cos\theta=1\Rightarrow\cos\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\Rightarrow\theta=30^\circ$.

questions.q: If $2\vec{a}.\vec{b} = |\vec{a}|.|\vec{b}|$ then the angle between $\vec{a}$ & $\vec{b}$ is
questions.explanation: $2|\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta=|\vec a||\vec b| \Rightarrow \cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \theta=60°$.

questions.q: If $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are unit vectors then what is the angle between $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ for $\sqrt{3}\vec{a}-\vec{b}$ to be unit vector?
questions.explanation: $|\sqrt3\vec a-\vec b|^2=1 \Rightarrow 3-2\sqrt3\cos\theta+1=1 \Rightarrow \cos\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2} \Rightarrow \theta=30°$.

questions.q: Suppose $\vec{a}+\vec{b}+\vec{c}=0$, $|\vec{a}|=3$, $|\vec{b}|=5$, $|\vec{c}|=7$, then the angle between $\vec{a}$ & $\vec{b}$ is
questions.explanation: Since $\vec c=-(\vec a+\vec b)$, $49=9+25+2\vec a\cdot\vec b \Rightarrow \vec a\cdot\vec b=7.5$; $\cos\theta=7.5/15=0.5 \Rightarrow \theta=\pi/3$.

questions.q: If $a=3, b=4, c=5$ each one of $\vec a,\vec b$ & $\vec c$ is perpendicular to the sum of the remaining then $|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|$ is equal to
questions.explanation: The perpendicularity conditions make $\vec a,\vec b,\vec c$ mutually perpendicular, so $|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=9+16+25=50$, giving $5\sqrt2$.

questions.q: The value of x if $x(\hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k})$ is a unit vector is
questions.explanation: $|x|\sqrt{1+1+1}=1 \Rightarrow x=\pm\dfrac{1}{\sqrt3}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a = i + 2j + 2k$, $|\vec b| = 5$ and the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, then the area of the triangle formed by these two vectors as two sides is
questions.explanation: Area $=\dfrac12|\vec a||\vec b|\sin\theta=\dfrac12(3)(5)\left(\dfrac12\right)=\dfrac{15}{4}$.

questions.q: Let $\vec a = i - 2j + 3k$; if $\vec b$ is a vector such that $\vec a \cdot \vec b = |\vec b|^2$ and $|\vec a - \vec b| = \sqrt7$, then $|\vec b| =$ ____
questions.explanation: $|\vec a-\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2-2\vec a\cdot\vec b+|\vec b|^2=14-2|\vec b|^2+|\vec b|^2=14-|\vec b|^2=7\Rightarrow|\vec b|=\sqrt7$.

questions.q: If direction cosines of a vector of magnitude 3 are $\dfrac23, -\dfrac{a}{3}, \dfrac23$ and $a > 0$, then vector is ____
questions.explanation: Direction cosines satisfy $\left(\frac23\right)^2+\left(\frac a3\right)^2+\left(\frac23\right)^2=1\Rightarrow a=1$; vector $=3\left(\frac23,-\frac13,\frac23\right)=2i-j+2k$. (The printed \"a\" was smudged in the paper, so KEA awarded a grace mark.)

questions.q: Let $\vec a = i + 2j + k$, $\vec b = i - j + k$ and $\vec c = i + j - k$; a vector in the plane $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ whose projection on $\vec c$ is $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt3}$ is ____
questions.explanation: A vector $x\vec a+y\vec b$ in the plane must have equal first and third components; only $4i-j+4k$ satisfies this, and its projection on $\vec c$ has magnitude $1/\sqrt3$.

questions.q: The area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are $\hat i + \hat k$ and $2\hat i + \hat j + \hat k$ is
questions.explanation: Cross product $(\hat i+\hat k)\times(2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k) = \hat i(0-1)-\hat j(1-2)+\hat k(1-0) = -\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$, magnitude $\sqrt{3}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ are two unit vectors inclined at an angle $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$, then the value of $|\vec a + \vec b|$ is
The value of $[\vec a - \vec b\ \ \vec b - \vec c\ \ \vec c - \vec a]$ is equal to
questions.explanation: The vectors $\vec a-\vec b$, $\vec b-\vec c$, $\vec c-\vec a$ sum to zero, so they are coplanar and their scalar triple product is 0.

questions.q: If $\vec a=(1,2,3)$, $\vec b=(2,-1,1)$, $\vec c=(3,2,1)$ and $\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\alpha\vec a+\beta\vec b+\gamma\vec c$, then
questions.explanation: By $\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec b(\vec a\cdot\vec c)-\vec c(\vec a\cdot\vec b)=10\vec b-3\vec c$, giving $\alpha=0,\beta=10,\gamma=-3$ (KEA awarded a grace mark for this question).

questions.q: If $\vec a\perp\vec b$ and $(\vec a+\vec b)\perp(\vec a+m\vec b)$, then $m=$
questions.explanation: Expanding the dot product using $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$ gives $|\vec a|^2+m|\vec b|^2=0\Rightarrow m=-|\vec a|^2/|\vec b|^2$.

questions.q: If $\vec a,\vec b,\vec c$ are unit vectors such that $\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec 0$, then $\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a=$
questions.explanation: Squaring $\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0$ gives $3+2(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a)=0$, so the sum is $-3/2$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$ is a vector perpendicular to both $\vec b$ and $\vec c$, then
questions.explanation: Since $\vec a$ is parallel to $\vec b\times\vec c$, their cross product vanishes.

questions.q: If $\vec a, \vec b$ and $\vec c$ are three non-coplanar vectors and $\vec p, \vec q$ and $\vec r$ are vectors defined by $\vec p = \dfrac{\vec b \times \vec c}{[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]}$, $\vec q = \dfrac{\vec c \times \vec a}{[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]}$ and $\vec r = \dfrac{\vec a \times \vec b}{[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]}$, then the value of $(\vec a + \vec b) \cdot \vec p + (\vec b + \vec c) \cdot \vec q + (\vec c + \vec a) \cdot \vec r =$
questions.explanation: $\vec p,\vec q,\vec r$ form the reciprocal system, so $\vec a\cdot\vec p=1,\vec b\cdot\vec p=\vec c\cdot\vec p=0$ (similarly for $\vec q,\vec r$). Each bracket reduces to $1$, giving a total of $3$.

questions.q: If $(\vec a \times \vec b)^2 + (\vec a \cdot \vec b)^2 = 144$ and $|\vec a| = 4$, then $|\vec b| =$
questions.explanation: Using the identity $(\vec a\times\vec b)^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2$, we get $16|\vec b|^2=144$, so $|\vec b|=3$.

questions.q: If $\hat i + \hat j - \hat k$ and $2\hat i - 3\hat j + \hat k$ are adjacent sides of a parallelogram, then the lengths of its diagonals are
questions.explanation: Sum $=3\hat i-2\hat j$, magnitude $\sqrt{13}$; difference $=-\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k$, magnitude $\sqrt{21}$. Diagonals are $\sqrt{21},\sqrt{13}$.

questions.q: If the volume of the parallelopiped formed by three non-coplanar vectors $\vec a, \vec b$ and $\vec c$ is 4 cubic units, then $[\vec a \times \vec b\ \ \vec b \times \vec c\ \ \vec c \times \vec a] =$
questions.explanation: $[\vec a\times\vec b\ \ \vec b\times\vec c\ \ \vec c\times\vec a]=[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]^2=4^2=16$.

questions.q: If $\vec a, \vec b$ and $\vec c$ are unit vectors such that $\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec 0$ then angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is ...........
questions.explanation: $|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=0$ gives $3+2(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a)=0$. By symmetry each dot product is $-\dfrac12$, so $\cos\theta=-\dfrac12$, i.e. $\theta=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$.

questions.q: If $\vec a, \vec b$ and $\vec c$ are noncoplanar, then the value of $\vec a\cdot\left\{\dfrac{\vec b\times\vec c}{3\vec b\cdot(\vec c\times\vec a)}\right\}-\vec b\cdot\left\{\dfrac{\vec c\times\vec a}{2\vec c\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)}\right\}$ is ............
questions.explanation: Since $\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec b\cdot(\vec c\times\vec a)=\vec c\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)=[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=V$, the expression equals $\dfrac{V}{3V}-\dfrac{V}{2V}=\dfrac13-\dfrac12=-\dfrac16$.

questions.q: If $2\hat i+3\hat j$, $\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$ and $\lambda\hat i+4\hat j+2\hat k$ taken in an order are coterminous edges of a parallelopiped of volume 2 Cu units, then value of $\lambda$ is ............
questions.explanation: The scalar triple product $\begin{vmatrix}2&3&0\\1&1&1\\lambda&4&2\end{vmatrix}=3\lambda-10$. Setting $|3\lambda-10|=2$ gives $\lambda=4$ or $\lambda=8/3$; among the options $\lambda=4$.

questions.q: A unit vector perpendicular to both $\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$ and $2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k$ is ............
questions.explanation: $(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\times(2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k)=2\hat i-\hat j-\hat k$, which has magnitude $\sqrt6$; dividing by this gives the unit vector.

questions.q: If $\vec a$, $\vec b$ and $\vec c$ are nonzero coplanar vectors, then $\left[2\vec a-\vec b\ \ 3\vec b-\vec c\ \ 4\vec c-\vec a\right]=$
questions.explanation: Since $\vec a,\vec b,\vec c$ are coplanar, every linear combination of them also lies in that plane, so the scalar triple product of any three such combinations is always $0$.

questions.q: A space vector makes the angles $150^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ with the positive direction of X- and Y-axes. The angle made by the vector with the positive direction of Z-axis is
questions.explanation: Using $\cos^2150^\circ+\cos^260^\circ+\cos^2\gamma=1$: $3/4+1/4+\cos^2\gamma=1$, so $\cos\gamma=0$, i.e. $\gamma=90^\circ$.

questions.q: If $\vec a$, $\vec b$ and $\vec c$ are unit vectors, such that $\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec 0$, then $3\vec a\cdot\vec b+2\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a=$
questions.explanation: By symmetry the three unit vectors are mutually at $120^\circ$, so each dot product equals $-1/2$; then $3(-1/2)+2(-1/2)+(-1/2)=-3$.

questions.q: If $i, j, k$ are unit vectors along the positive direction of X-, Y- and Z-axes, then a FALSE statement in the following is
questions.explanation: The cyclic sum $i\cdot(j\times k)+j\cdot(k\times i)+k\cdot(i\times j)=1+1+1=3\ne0$, so statement 1 is false; the other three cyclic sums correctly evaluate to $0$.

questions.q: If $\vec a \cdot \vec b = -|\vec a||\vec b|$, then the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is
questions.explanation: $\vec a \cdot \vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta = -|\vec a||\vec b|$ gives $\cos\theta = -1$, so $\theta = 180^\circ$.

questions.q: If $\vec a + 2\vec b + 3\vec c = \vec O$, then $\vec a \times \vec b + \vec b \times \vec c + \vec c \times \vec a =$
questions.explanation: From $\vec a = -2\vec b - 3\vec c$: $\vec a\times\vec b = 3(\vec b\times\vec c)$ and $\vec c\times\vec a = 2(\vec b\times\vec c)$, so the sum is $6(\vec b\times\vec c)$; note $3(\vec c\times\vec a)=3\cdot2(\vec b\times\vec c)=6(\vec b\times\vec c)$ too, so options (1) and (3) give the same value.

questions.q: If the volume of the parallelopiped with $\vec a$, $\vec b$ and $\vec c$ as coterminous edges is 40 cubic units, then the volume of the parallelopiped having $\vec b + \vec c$, $\vec c + \vec a$ and $\vec a + \vec b$ as coterminous edges in cubic units is
questions.explanation: The volume with edges $\vec b+\vec c, \vec c+\vec a, \vec a+\vec b$ is always $2[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c] = 2\times40=80$.
